title: stitch-docket-and-telemetry-sketch-apr-2026
body:
Purpose:
A compact runbook for the 'Stitch' micro-release (April 2026). Focused on a low-risk patchset that touches routing, KV-cache warming, and a small telemetry schema change. This doc is intentionally lightweight — operational checklist + hour-by-hour cadence + annotated release notes (draft). Use as the source of truth for on-call/night shift and for the preflight signoff call.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Window: 2026-04-20 22:00 - 2026-04-21 02:00 PT
- Scope: routing tweaks (canary 5%), KV cache pre-warm addition, schema v2 telemetry event (backwards compatible).
- Risk level: LOW-MED (config-only + telemetry).
- Rollback: automated flag flip + disable warming + revert telemetry mapping (2-step).
- Primary contacts: Maya T. (release lead), Diego M. (runtime), Priya K. (telemetry/observability), Samir P. (platform ops).

Calendar (hour-by-hour, local PT):
- 18:00 - 19:30: Preflight team sync (all collaborators). Finalize JIRA checkboxes, confirm PR green, confirm canary routing artifact present.
- 19:30 - 20:30: Preflight tests: canary simulation (synthetic traffic generator), end-to-end smoke on staging, golden-key latency sweep.
- 20:30 - 21:15: Final sign-off meeting (15 min). Chat channel pinned messages, preflight checklist walk-through.
- 21:15 - 21:45: Quiet window begins for external deploys; throttle non-critical background jobs.
- 22:00: Deploy to canary lane (5% traffic). Start telemetry sampler.
- 22:00 - 23:00: Watchman window 1 (observe errors, tail logs, latency P50/P95, failed request ratio).
- 23:00: If stable, ramp to 25% for 30m.
- 23:30 - 00:15: Watchman window 2. If stable, ramp to 60% (00:15).
- 00:15 - 00:45: Full ramp to 100%. Verify rollout target metrics.
- 00:45 - 02:00: Post-rollout hang (24h extended telemetry retention flag baked if needed).

Preflight checklist (must be green before 21:15 sign-off):
- [ ] PRs merged: platform#4521, runtime#381 (linked in JIRA).
- [ ] Infra changes: none (config only).
- [ ] Canary config validated: routing policy v1.3 loaded and smoke-tested.
- [ ] KV pre-warm list generated and validated against canary set.
- [ ] Telemetry mapping: schema v2 appended with fallthrough for v1 events.
- [ ] Alerting hooks: added sample alerts for new telemetry tags (pri: P2).
- [ ] Rollback playbook posted to channel and pinned.
- [ ] On-call roster confirmed for 6h after full rollout.
- [ ] Post-release retrospective placeholder calendar invite created (owners: Maya, Priya).

Release notes (DRAFT — to ship with release audit log):
Title: Stitch — routing/caching/telemetry maintenance (Apr 2026)
Summary: A targeted update to routing heuristics to improve small-request latency tail, add proactive KV pre-warm for cold clients, and introduce a telemetry schema v2 tag to enable per-tenant sampling. No model or user-visible behavior changes expected.
Changes: 
- Routing: introduce preferential pathing for short seq requests (feature flagged; canary 5% -> global). Relates to ENG-2781.
- KV pre-warm: emit warming jobs for priority tenants during low-traffic windows; configurable TTL.
- Telemetry: appended 'client_tier' enum to event schema; defaulted to 'unknown' if missing to preserve v1 consumers.
Notes to customers: No API changes. Any downstream consumers using raw telemetry streams should tolerate unknown enum values.
Known issues (open):
- Some tenants with extreme request fanout may see delayed warmup; tracked in INF-903. Mitigation: temporary TTL bump / force-warm script.
- Observability dashboard needs an extra panel for 'client_tier' distribution (Priya to own).

Rollback plan (fastest route):
- Step 1: Flip rollout flag to previous routing config (automated rollback job).
- Step 2: Disable warming jobs via feature toggle (platform console).
- Step 3: Revert telemetry mapping with rollforward bridge (scripts in infra repo).
- Validation: run canary-sim traffic; check failed request ratio and P95 within 10% of baseline.
Estimated time-to-rollback: 6-18 minutes (depends on warming job propagation).

Monitoring & telemetry sampling plan (Priya K.):
- Primary KPIs to watch: failed_request_ratio, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, kv_warm_success_rate, error_budget_consumed.
- Sample dashboards: 'stitch-canary' live view (panel id: TBD), 'kv-warm' heatmap.
- Sampling: 1% continuous system tracer + 100% of synthetic tester requests (for clarity).
- Alerts and thresholds: 
  * failed_request_ratio > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> P1 alert to #stitch-run.
  * p95_latency increase > 40% from baseline over 5m -> P2 to on-call.
  * kv_warm_success_rate < 90% for 10m -> P2.

Night-of operator script (quick commands):
- Check canary status: ./tools/rollout status --id stitch-2026-04 --lane canary
- Tail service logs (canary): k tail -n stitch-canary --since 1h | grep -E "ERROR|WARN|KV_PREWARM"
- Re-run synthetic: ./tools/synthetic run --profile stitch-smoke --duration 10m
- Flip flag (rollback): ./tools/flags set routing_policy=stable --run-id stitch-rollback

Open questions / decisions pending:
- Should we enable TTL auto-bump for tenants with >100k reqs/day? (Decision needed by 2026-04-15)
- Do we want a permanent 'client_tier' breakdown in the global billing pipeline? (Finance/Revenue sync required)
- Confirm retention for telemetry v2: 30d or 90d? (ops + compliance input)

Post-release notes / retrospective agenda (owners: Maya, Priya):
- 24h telemetry review (verify no P1s).
- 72h warmup effectiveness sampling (compare cold-start tail).
- Quick retro: what went well, what to change, action items (owner + due dates).

Notes to self (Maya) — scratchpad: 
- Ping Samir to ensure the warm list generator runs at 03:00 PT with tenant snapshot.
- Add one-off script in rollback playbook to accelerate telemetry revert if mapping errors observed.
- Reminder: update the public-facing release notes page after the postmortem (mark 'minor' in release channel).

Appendix (useful links & the tiny checklist):
- Quick test PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521
- Runtime patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/381
- JIRA epic: RELEASE-2026-APR
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RELEASE/Apr+2026+Stitch+Runbook

-- end of sketch --

Status: draft — please comment inline in this doc; I'll consolidate and push a cleaned release-note draft to the public channel the morning after the release.
